p: more come into thee the uncircumcised: No wicked tyrant, who will subvert God's true religion and oppress the conscience.
dust: Put off the garments of sorrow and heaviness and put on the apparel of joy and gladness.
nothing: The Babylonians paid nothing to me for you: therefore I will take you again without ransom.
down in times past into Egypt: When Jacob went there in times of famine.

oppressed them without cause: The Egyptians might pretend some reason to oppress my people because they went there and remained among them, but the Assyrians have no title to excuse their tyranny by, and therefore I will punish them more than I did the Egyptians.
blasphemed: That is, by the wicked, who think that I have no power to deliver them.

beautiful upon the mountains are the: Signifying that the joy and good tidings of their deliverance would make their affliction in the mean time more easy: but this is chiefly meant of the spiritual joy, as in Na 1:15, Ro 10:15.
Thy watchmen shall lift up the: The prophets who are your watchmen will publish your deliverance: this was begun under Zerubbabel, Ezra and Nehemiah, but was accomplished under Christ.
bare his holy arm in the: As ready to smite his enemies and to deliver his people.
Depart ye: He warns the faithful not to pollute themselves with the superstitions of the Babylonians, as Isa 48:20, 2Co 6:17.

bear the vessels of the LORD: For the time is at hand that the priests and Levites chiefly (and so by them all the people, who will be as the Levites in this office) will carry home vessels of the temple which Nebuchadnezzar had taken away.
with haste: As your fathers did out of Egypt.
servant shall deal prudently: Meaning Christ, by whom our spiritual deliverance would be wrought of which this was a sign.
marred more than any man: In the corrupt judgment of man, Christ in his person was not valued.
shall he sprinkle many nations: He will spread his word through many nations.
mouths at him: In sign of reverence, and as being astonished at his excellency.
consider: By the preaching of the gospel.
